tasks.subject: Task 1: tools.json
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Define the four read-only tools in Anthropic's flat {name, description, input_schema} shape.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools.json`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Valid JSON array of length 4
- Each entry has name, description, input_schema (no OpenAI function nesting)
- Tools: gh_pr_view, gh_issue_view (number req, repo opt), list_directory, print_file (path req)

**Verify:** `jq -e 'type=="array" and length==4' tools.json` -> true

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools.json"], "verifyCommand": "jq -e 'length==4' tools.json", "acceptanceCriteria": ["valid JSON array length 4", "flat Anthropic shape", "four read-only tools"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: shai-read + test harness
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wrap stdin into a message event, and establish the offline test harness (stubbed curl+gh) that later tasks extend.

**Files:**
- Create: `shai-read`
- Create: `tests/tests.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- echo hi | ./shai-read -> {type:message, source:user, payload:{text:hi}}
- --system sets source to system
- Empty stdin -> no output, exit 0
- tests/tests.sh runs fully offline (curl+gh stubs on PATH), non-zero on failure

**Verify:** `./tests/tests.sh` -> read: assertions pass; final line ALL TESTS PASSED

```json:metadata
{"files": ["shai-read", "tests/tests.sh"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/tests.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["message envelope with user source", "--system source", "empty input passthrough", "offline stubbed harness"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: shai-context
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Reduce history JSONL to {system, messages} in Anthropic shape - pure jq, windowed on user-message boundaries, folding consecutive tool_result events into one user turn.

**Files:**
- Create: `shai-context`
- Modify: `tests/tests.sh` (append context section)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- system = all system-source message texts joined with \n\n
- user -> {role:user,content:text}; assistant -> {role:assistant,content:<stored blocks>}
- consecutive tool_result -> one user turn of tool_result blocks (tool_use_id, is_error) after the assistant turn
- window keeps events from the last N user turns (default 10, --window N), starting on a user boundary
- malformed lines skipped (try fromjson catch null)

**Verify:** `./tests/tests.sh` -> context: assertions pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["shai-context", "tests/tests.sh"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/tests.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["system extraction", "user/assistant role mapping preserving blocks", "tool_result folding with tool_use_id", "user-boundary windowing", "malformed-line tolerance"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: shai-eval
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Build the request payload and call the Messages API (non-streaming), emitting one assistant event (or an error event).

**Files:**
- Create: `shai-eval`
- Modify: `tests/tests.sh` (append eval section)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Payload {model,max_tokens,system,messages,tools?}; defaults claude-opus-4-8/16000; --tools adds tools.json; no thinking, no stream
- --dry-run prints payload and exits; --health-check exits 1 iff ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset
- POST to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with x-api-key + anthropic-version: 2023-06-01, curl --max-time 120
- HTTP 200 -> assistant event {content,stop_reason}; non-2xx or .type==error -> error event

**Verify:** `./tests/tests.sh` -> eval: assertions pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["shai-eval", "tests/tests.sh"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/tests.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["payload build + defaults", "dry-run + health-check", "correct endpoint/headers/timeout", "assistant vs error event parsing"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: shai-dispatch
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Run tool_use blocks from the latest assistant turn, emit truncated tool_result events, and signal the loop via exit code (1 = ran, 0 = none).

**Files:**
- Create: `shai-dispatch`
- Modify: `tests/tests.sh` (append dispatch section)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- No tool_use -> exit 0, no output
- tool_use -> one tool_result per block (tool_use_id echoed), exit 1
- gh wrapped in timeout 30s; output truncated to 8000 bytes
- Tool failure / unknown tool -> tool_result with is_error:true

**Verify:** `./tests/tests.sh` -> dispatch: assertions pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["shai-dispatch", "tests/tests.sh"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/tests.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tool_use extraction", "read-only dispatch + timeout", "8KB truncation", "tool_use_id pairing + is_error", "exit-code loop contract"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: shai-print
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Render events for humans - assistant text blocks and Error: lines; --debug also shows tool activity.

**Files:**
- Create: `shai-print`
- Modify: `tests/tests.sh` (append print section)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Assistant event -> its text block(s)
- error event -> Error: <text>
- --debug shows tool_use/tool_result; default hides them

**Verify:** `./tests/tests.sh` -> print: assertions pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["shai-print", "tests/tests.sh"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/tests.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["assistant text extraction", "error line formatting", "--debug mode"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: shai (entry/REPL) + integration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire the standalone filters into the read/eval/dispatch/print loop, with startup health-check, state init, and a seeded system prompt.

**Files:**
- Create: `shai`
- Modify: `tests/tests.sh` (append integration section)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Startup runs shai-eval --health-check; creates ~/.shai/ (honoring SHAI_HOME); seeds a system message if history empty
- One prompt drives read -> context -> eval -> print, then loops shai-dispatch while it exits 1
- exit/quit ends the loop; events appended to history.jsonl

**Verify:** `./tests/tests.sh` -> shai: integration assertions pass; ALL TESTS PASSED

```json:metadata
{"files": ["shai", "tests/tests.sh"], "verifyCommand": "./tests/tests.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["startup health-check + init + seed", "read/eval/print pipeline", "dispatch loop via exit code", "exit/quit + history logging"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: README.md
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Document setup and usage so a new user can run the MVP.

**Files:**
- Create: `README.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Setup: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, gh auth login, jq/curl prereqs
- Quick start via ./shai; a composable one-shot pipe example
- Documents the read-only tool set and the append-only ~/.shai/history.jsonl model
- Notes MVP scope + links the design spec

**Verify:** `test -f README.md && grep -q 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' README.md && grep -q './shai' README.md` -> exit 0

